name: dsh-notebook-studio
description: dsh-notebook-studio 是 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：上传多篇 PDF，用提示词做文献综述、关键信息提取与研究设计，并生成带页码引用的报告（DOCX/PDF）或演示文稿（PPTX/PDF）。 | dsh-notebook-studio is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: upload PDF papers and use prompts for a literature review, key-finding extraction and a study design, then generate page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).
